description: Erection of a detached single storey outbuilding positioned in the house's front garden.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unreferenced Location Plan; Unreferenced Proposed Block Plan; 403720 (Plans and Elevations); Planning Statement; Received:  19/05/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the detached single storey front outbuilding hereby approved.

Condition : 4 - The detached single storey front outbuilding hereby approved, located in the house's front garden, shall only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the house at No. 26 Ernest Gardens described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes).
Condition : 5 - The rear window of the detached single storey front outbuilding hereby approved shall be obscure glazed and permanently retained as such.
